prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity north-star comp, SANAD hybrid composition C, portrait mobile operating screen
Input images: Image 1 contributes mashrabiya daylight, porcelain surfaces, crisp financial typography, and bilingual dignity. Image 2 contributes a parametric Arabic counterseal as a state diagram and a lilac/mint/pink logic. Do not inherit their incorrect figures, extra navigation, or any invented provider brand.
Primary request: Create a balanced “shared folio” Finance composition for SANAD. One continuous porcelain sheet should visibly connect the invoice, route comparison, fee ownership, and two-party agreement. Mashrabiya daylight frames the sheet; a compact counterseal changes from open at Compare to closed at Sign.
Structure: edge-to-edge 9:19.5 portrait app viewport, no phone frame. Header with “SANAD” and “سند”, “Local prototype”, help/reset. Finance heading and subtitle “One invoice. Every cost in view.” A linked conversation chip. A thin Compare → Agree → Sign rail built from three stages of the same parametric Arabic seal. Main folio: invoice “SF-1048”, “480 bottles · Organic extra virgin olive oil”, exact “€6,000.00”. Three stacked quote rows only: “Bank wire”, “Specialist transfer”, “USDC route” with “Simulation”. Select Bank wire. Show exact selected outcome prominently: “Buyer pays C$9,269.00” and “Supplier receives €5,965.00–€5,985.00”. Include “Who covers possible recipient fees?” with a porcelain select set to “Deduct from supplier receipt”. Include compact disclosure “Synthetic demo assumptions · not live quotes”. Primary button “Create shared agreement”. Two-item bottom nav: Chat, Finance selected.
Composition: the continuous folio occupies most of the viewport; no dashboard cards. A diagonal daylight/shadow field provides atmosphere above and outside the folio. Counterseal geometry appears only in the progress rail, selected radio, and button terminal; do not place a giant decorative seal behind text. Exact amounts are oversized and tabular. Lilac, mint, and pink correspond consistently to Compare, Agree, and Sign.
Palette: #FCFBF8, #E8D8FF, #BCEDE7, #2B2540, #FF8FCC, near-black ink.
Text verbatim where legible: “SANAD”, “سند”, “Local prototype”, “Finance”, “One invoice. Every cost in view.”, “SF-1048”, “480 bottles · Organic extra virgin olive oil”, “€6,000.00”, “Bank wire”, “Specialist transfer”, “USDC route”, “Simulation”, “Buyer pays”, “C$9,269.00”, “Supplier receives”, “€5,965.00–€5,985.00”, “Who covers possible recipient fees?”, “Deduct from supplier receipt”, “Synthetic demo assumptions · not live quotes”, “Create shared agreement”, “Chat”.
Constraints: one practical operating screen; synthetic demo only; no movement of money; no real providers or logos; no invented fees or timing beyond the exact supplied values; no bento layout; no poster; no device chrome; no watermark. Save/copy the final selected image into the current project at .impeccable/mocks/hybrid-c.webp.
